# Provenance-enriched read-only knowledge queries

This module implements a collection of read-only queries over the knowledge graph for code repositories. Each query returns detailed provenance and context, such as the origins of facts, relationships between code artifacts, and recent changes. This enables traceability and reliable assessment of the state of the repository without modifying data.
